posts.name: Hemory
posts.tagline: Keep listening. Searchable memory for your AI agents.
posts.description: Hemory comes from Hear + Memory. It's not meeting transcription: Hemory listens on the phone or Apple Watch you already own, and keeps every conversation as memory. Your day is auto-split into moments with speaker labels, then settles into a private, searchable memory. Connect it to Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any agent over MCP, and your AI finally has real context to revisit what you heard and build on it.

posts.name: Eclatira
posts.tagline: Conversational Video Agent That Plugs Into Any Stack
posts.description: Plug real-time conversational video AI into any application. Eclatira gives developers native voice-to-voice, live vision, and full-stack execution across custom APIs, MCPs, and 3,000+ apps. Ship autonomous multimodal video agents fast.

posts.name: Chit
posts.tagline: A printed receipt of your day in Claude Code
posts.description: Chit reads the Claude Code transcripts already on your disk and prints the day back as a receipt, grouped by project and ready to paste into a standup. A 777 KB Mac app. No Hammerspoon, no Python, no account, and no network code in the binary at all.

posts.name: MakerMap
posts.tagline: A living map of makers and what they’re building
posts.description: MakerMap is a living map of the maker world. Discover 4,000+ makers and products, search by niche, location, interests or what people are building, explore live profiles, and find people worth meeting. Add yourself and become part of the map.

posts.name: Paragraph Notes
posts.tagline: A private Markdown notes app for Mac
posts.description: Paragraph Notes is a privacy-focused Markdown notes app for Mac. Write in a simple, distraction-free plain text editor. Paragraph Notes collects no data and never connects to the internet. Notes are stored locally in an open, portable format. Use Paragraph Notes free for up to 20 notes. Upgrade to Pro with a one-time in-app purchase for unlimited notes.

posts.name: GoodSocials
posts.tagline: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Only authentic content
posts.description: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Writes high quality content, you approve it in a kanban board, it schedules so you post regularly, close to daily.

posts.name: Fewer
posts.tagline: The launcher that counts how often you pick up your phone
posts.description: An Android launcher built around pickups, not screen time. A quiet home screen shows today's task, how many times you've looked at your phone (and how many for nothing) and the six tools you actually use. Time sinks get a pause. No server, no account, no ads.

posts.name: Kleanly
posts.tagline: One tap in the notch locks your keyboard and trackpad
posts.description: Kleanly lives in your MacBook's notch. Tap it once and your keyboard and trackpad are locked, so you can wipe everything down while your video keeps playing. Kids can slap the keys during a cartoon and nothing gets typed. Double tap the trackpad when you're done. New since our first launch: the notch control, in-app updates, moving your license to a new Mac yourself, and a small tab on displays without a notch.

posts.name: Psst
posts.tagline: A shared shopping list that remembers what things cost
posts.description: Psst is a shared shopping list. The useful part is that it remembers what you paid. Photograph a receipt and the lines come back structured, each one showing a crop of the row it came from and what that item cost last time, and where. Most of the work went into not saying so when it isn't sure. Two prices in different units are never compared, and comparison is on unit price, not the line total: buying 2kg instead of 1kg is not a price rise. iOS and Android.

posts.name: Lisen
posts.tagline: Free Read Aloud with Cartesia Voices
posts.description: Free read aloud for any article with your Cartesia voices. No subscription on top of your Cartesia plan.

posts.name: SOUND
posts.tagline: Give every Mac app its own EQ, volume, and speaker.
posts.description: macOS has one volume slider and no equalizer. SOUND gives every playing app its own 8-band EQ, independent volume, and output device—right from the menu bar. No virtual audio driver or account; audio stays on your Mac. Free and available in 10 languages.

posts.name: VehicleERP
posts.tagline: VehicleERP - Used Car Management Software
posts.description: VehicleERP is used car management software built for dealers who buy, sell, and manage vehicles. Track inventory, purchases, expenses, sales, payments, GST bills, partners, staff, branches, and profit on one platform. AI helps price vehicles, scan documents, spot ageing stock and mistakes, forecast performance, and answer questions using your business data.

posts.name: What to Order
posts.tagline: Find food you’ll love on any restaurant menu
posts.description: Ever sat down at The Cheesecake Factory and been handed the menu? 331 items. You flip through it, get nowhere, and order the same thing as last time. What to Order works the other way around. Tell it what you’re in the mood for and it checks every dish on the menu for you. “Spicy” works. “Spicy vegetarian” too. Ask for “Thanksgiving dinner for 2” and you get a whole order, pumpkin cheesecake included. We have 7 US chains so far. Eating somewhere else? Snap a photo of the menu. It’s free.

posts.name: ZenMode OS · Android Launcher
posts.tagline: Good phone habits! paid in gold, all with your friends.
posts.description: ZenMode OS is an open source Android launcher that makes the intentional choice easier than the impulsive one. One Zen Score, real accountability, and rewards that land in gold instead of dopamine.

posts.name: Big Weather
posts.tagline: Menu Bar Forecast, now with AI Insights
posts.description: Big Weather puts the weather in your Mac's menu bar: the days ahead as one curve you can scrub through, UV hour by hour, and with Premium, AI insights and official weather warnings.

posts.name: Bump
posts.tagline: Your AI collections team for email and WhatsApp
posts.description: Bump is an AI collections engine for accounts receivable. It works every overdue invoice to paid — chasing across email and WhatsApp, reading replies, tracking promises and payment plans, and escalating on its own — so getting paid runs itself. Like adding a collections team, without hiring one.

posts.name: Farao
posts.tagline: Trade with friends, post thesis, earn money
posts.description: Follow your friends and other traders whose records are visible, read the thesis behind every position, and mirror the trade at your own size.

posts.name: ButterShare
posts.tagline: Share Anything, to Anyone. No File Limits
posts.description: ButterShare allows you to share files of any size directly between devices without the need for cloud storage or sign-ups. With a simple 3-step process, you can send files instantly using a 6-character room code. The service ensures privacy with end-to-end encryption, making it ideal for sharing large files securely.

posts.name: Finantly
posts.tagline: All your finances in one place — budgets and investments.
posts.description: Finantly brings your accounts, budgets, investments and debts into one clear view. Import bank CSV files with auto-categories that learn your choices, track net worth in real time across currencies, and plan with FIRE, car, real estate and loan calculators built on your data — not guesswork. Full control over your money, no spreadsheets required.

posts.name: TokExport
posts.tagline: Export TikTok followers, following & comments in seconds
posts.description: TokExport makes TikTok data export simple. Export follower lists, following lists and video comments to CSV, Excel or JSON. Built for social media research, audience analysis and content research, with resume support for long exports.

posts.name: photobid
posts.tagline: The Internet’s Billboard
posts.description: The Internet’s Billboard for Photos PhotoBid is a social platform where photos compete for the spotlight. Post your best moments, discover creators, and bid to push the photos you believe deserve more attention. As posts compete, the community decides what rises, what gets noticed, and what takes the spotlight. Think of it as a billboard for the internet — where anyone can put something up, compete for attention, and earn their place in the spotlight.

posts.name: Asụsụ Ọma
posts.tagline: Learn Igbo with guided lessons, real Igbo voices and games
posts.description: Igbo has tens of millions of speakers and almost nowhere to learn it properly. Asụsụ Ọma is a free Igbo learning app: guided lessons, games, folktales, and every phrase recorded by a native speaker. No ads, no subscription, nothing behind a payment.

posts.name: CozyToolkit
posts.tagline: Free everyday tools for creators
posts.description: Free online tools for images, PDFs, writing and video. Compress, convert and create in one CozyToolkit brings image and PDF tools, writing, video utilities, QR codes and short links into one friendly website. Everyday tools are free; hosted features have free allowances.cozy place. Sign in for unlimited everyday tools.

posts.name: Puzzly
posts.tagline: Turn any pic into a multiplayer jigsaw puzzle. No sign-ups
posts.description: Puzzly turns any photo into a real-time collaborative jigsaw puzzle for 1 to 6 players. Upload an image, create a room, share one link, and start solving together instantly. See live cursors, grabs, reactions and merges as they happen. No signup, no accounts, no ads. Solo mode and challenge links are included too.

posts.name: Prompt Workbench
posts.tagline: Open-source Prompt Management solution
posts.description: Prompt Workbench is a local, open-source developer application for creating, versioning, testing, comparing and publishing LLM prompts and linear prompt chains. Develop and compare prompts locally, then ship the exact versions you tested as ordinary, portable files that any language can load — with no cloud account and no vendor lock-in.

posts.name: MemoryLane
posts.tagline: Rediscover the memories sitting on your drives.
posts.description: MemoryLane indexes the photo and video folders you already have and turns them into a fast, rediscoverable library on your own machine. Built for people with large archives and for photographers.

posts.name: bidthe1.com
posts.tagline: Get some traffic with BidThe1 (Grab a spot)
posts.description: You already pay to grow. You just call it “sponsored.” So we built something different for your products + people. Whether you're promoting a product, website, app, profile, or creator - you’re just a dollar away from getting seen. 💸

posts.name: SKID
posts.tagline: AI decision engine for Dubai real estate off-plan projects.
posts.description: AI property decision engine for Dubai. Check if an off plan project is overpriced, see fair value from DLD comps, and get a clear buy, negotiate, wait, or walk-away decision. Not a marketplace.

posts.name: Dots-In
posts.tagline: Your Living Twin that makes the internet work for you
posts.description: Dots-In builds a Living Twin that learns from your behaviour, goals and digital life — not just your prompts. It personalises your AI conversations, feed, learning, productivity and network around you. Connect the tools you already use, let your Twin understand your patterns, and turn the internet from something designed to control your attention into something that actually works for you.

posts.name: Realwater — Drink water. We track it
posts.tagline: A beautifully simple way to track your daily hydration
posts.description: Realwater is a hydration tracker that turns your daily goal into a living sphere of water. Log drinks in one tap, watch the level rise, and get reminders that fit your routine. Set a goal based on your body, activity and climate, track streaks and trends, and customize the experience. It works offline with no account, and Premium is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: Clothys AI
posts.tagline: See Yourself In Every Outfit
posts.description: Clothsy AI puts a virtual fitting room on the product page. Shoppers add a photo and see themselves in the outfit before they buy.

posts.name: biomes
posts.tagline: Save multi-monitor app layouts & launch with hotkeys
posts.description: For people with more than one interest: biomes is a free, open-source Windows workspace manager built to remove setup friction and trigger focus habits. Group your apps, tools, and notes into custom multi-monitor layouts and launch them instantly with global hotkeys. Switch seamlessly between coding, design, and study routines without losing momentum—all stored 100% locally on your PC.

posts.name: Onto
posts.tagline: Your website, readable to AI agents
posts.description: AI agents read your site as raw HTML, and you can’t see them. Onto serves them clean Markdown at the same URL, while people and Google get your page as before, and shows you which agents came. Plus an AIO score, and a Read API and MCP for builders.

posts.name: Flag Quiz
posts.tagline: Learn the flags of the world
posts.description: Ireland or Ivory Coast? Slovakia or Slovenia? Flag Quiz helps you learn them all, one at a time. The ones you miss come back until they stick, and mnemonics make the tricky ones unforgettable. Learn every flag, and you'll hold the whole world in your mind.

posts.name: Untangle
posts.tagline: Capture messy thoughts by voice. AI organizes them.
posts.description: Untangle is a voice-first iPhone app for capturing thoughts before they disappear. Speak naturally, let AI organize the transcript into a clear note, then decide whether it becomes an idea, task, note, or something for later. Unlike AI tools that decide for you, Untangle keeps meaning and next steps in your hands. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets make capture one tap away.

posts.name: Brainlist Calendar
posts.tagline: every notes entry shows up in your list AND your calendar
posts.description: It's made from someone with ADHD for people who want to get tasks and events done. It helps you plan your day, with a list view that shows all events and tasks in one timeline AND a monthly calendar view that syncs automatically, as well as an Eisenhower importance/urgency Matrix and a spin-the-wheel picker for when you can't decide what to start with. With Brain Dump you quickly capture type or dictate a thought and then you can get back to it later without the note being buried away forever.

posts.name: Katteb Goals
posts.tagline: Give an AI agent a goal and a deadline, get a daily report
posts.description: A goal is an outcome with a deadline. Tell a Katteb agent what you want, like 20 new qualified leads every working day or 15 discovery calls in 30 days, and it plans the work, runs it on a schedule for weeks, remembers what it did and sends you a report every day. Start from 100 ready goals across leads, sales and marketing, or write your own. The Goals plan runs five agents at once. Goals are not guaranteed, and you can change or stop a goal at any time.

posts.name: Commit Land
posts.tagline: Your projects as a living town. Every push changes it.
posts.description: Commit Land turns your projects into living places. Connect GitHub and watch everything you build become an evolving isometric world where humans and AI agents build together. Claude Code and Codex join via MCP, post updates as they finish something, and you can see when they're working right now. Connect GitHub, pick the repos you want to show - choosing the level of summarization/anonymization for your project updates, and your Land is live...don't forget to follow your friends' projects too!

posts.name: nerfWatch()
posts.tagline: Daily AI benchmarks and community votes on model quality
posts.description: nerfWatch() tests AI models daily through their APIs, against each model's first week of tracking. See scores beside community votes, get alerts for declines and recoveries, and inspect the open-source engine. API tests, not chat-app tests.

posts.name: Docket
posts.tagline: Don't Rent. Own Your Agentic Support Centre.
posts.description: Docket answers your customers, hands the work to your coding agent, and keeps the changelog, roadmap and FAQ up to date automatically. One payment, no subscription, no seats. Unlimited products on every plan, including the free version. Docket is yours, so customise it to suit your needs. It sits on a subdomain of yours, under your brand. Docket allows you to create the Support Centre that you and your business needs.

posts.name: MapAnimate
posts.tagline: Flight Map Animation Generator
posts.description: MapAnimate lets you create cinematic animated map videos showcasing flight routes and travel journeys. Select your airports, design the flight path, and export a polished video in minutes—perfect for travel vlogs, presentations, and storytelling. Ideal for content creators, travel enthusiasts, and marketers who want to visualize journeys with professional-quality animations.

posts.name: Veritas
posts.tagline: Grow your organic traffic and get cited by AI
posts.description: Most AI-visibility tools stop at a dashboard. Veritas fixes what it finds. It tracks your Google rankings and whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews cite you, and who they cite instead. Then it drafts content from your own docs, with a source on every claim and nothing it can't source, and publishes it to WordPress in one click. Site audit, keywords, backlinks and local SEO included. Built for B2B teams.

posts.name: OBook Text To Speech
posts.tagline: Turn any PDF or ebook into a natural audiobook
posts.description: Obook turns PDFs, ebooks and classics into natural-sounding audiobooks. Unlike basic text-to-speech readers, Obook first uses AI to clean the text (skipping headers, page numbers and footnotes) and splits it into real chapters, so you hear the book, not the page layout. Choose from 32 narrators across 20+ languages and follow along with word-by-word highlighting synced to the audio. Built and run on our own GPU voice pipeline by a solo founder.

posts.name: DocxToWP
posts.tagline: Import 100 Word documents and schedule them in minutes
posts.description: Stop copy-pasting Word docs into WordPress. DocxToWP imports yourdocx with images, formatting & SEO meta intact — in under 60 seconds. Free version available, Pro at $39 one-time.

posts.name: WhenDo: AI Auto Clicker Macro
posts.tagline: Turn one sentence into an Android automation
posts.description: WhenDo turns one sentence into an Android automation. Describe a routine - "mute my phone on home Wi-Fi" - and AI builds the triggers, conditions, and actions, all editable. It's also a full auto clicker: record taps and swipes, schedule tasks, pick from 250+ triggers (app launches, Wi-Fi, calendar, location, NFC). No root needed, with optional Shizuku for deeper control. Free to use, with a one-time Pro unlock. No subscription.

posts.name: Beagle Bounce Android
posts.tagline: A cozy one-tap beagle runner through the seasons of Maine
posts.description: Beagle Bounce is a mobile game I built with AI, inspired by my beagle Sammy and our life in Maine. Run through all four Maine seasons, dodge obstacles, collect treats, unlock costumes and chase the global high score. The project started as an experiment to see how far I could take a personal idea using AI across design, assets and development. No ads, no IAP, and fully playable offline.

posts.name: Demo Data
posts.tagline: Anonymize live SaaS demos in one click.
posts.description: Demo Data is a Chrome extension that instantly swaps real names, emails, and revenue numbers with realistic fake data without breaking your CSS or page layout.

posts.name: I Am DrugFree
posts.tagline: Private sobriety tracking, one day at a time
posts.description: Track sober time, cravings, triggers and milestones on iPhone. Keep a private journal, see progress in widgets and use breathing, grounding and urge-timer tools when needed. Core tracking needs no account or public profile. An optional online Sober Coach uses Google Gemini with adult consent. Free download with optional purchases.

posts.name: Pray Shield
posts.tagline: A Scripture and prayer pause before you scroll
posts.description: Pray Shield adds a brief Scripture and prayer pause before selected distracting apps on iPhone. Build a prayer rhythm with Bible reading, reflections and a peaceful Eden experience with a little lamb. Screen Time management is free. Bible reading, prayer tools and Eden require Plus; current subscription prices and eligible trials are shown in the App Store.

posts.name: NumBan
posts.tagline: Report voicemail callback numbers, not spoofed caller ID.
posts.description: NumBan is the first app to combat phone scammers using the number they leave on your voicemail, which cannot be faked. Most apps block the caller's phone number, which is a spoofed caller ID. Users can simply share the voicemail with NumBan and our system will transcribe it, extract the number, look up the phone carrier, and report the number to their abuse team. When we detect that a number has been abandoned, we count it as a kill and increment our leaderboard!

posts.name: Time Zone Pro: World Clock
posts.tagline: Drag one slider and see the time in every city
posts.description: Stop doing time zone math in your head. Time Zone Pro puts all your cities on one screen, and when you drag the 24 hour slider, every clock moves together. You can see right away who's awake, who's asleep, and which hour works for everyone. It detects your local time zone, supports 12h and 24h formats, and lets you reorder cities however you like. Clean dark design, built for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Free to use, with an optional one time Pro unlock for extra themes.

posts.name: SteelType
posts.tagline: turns your voice into typed text and translates.
posts.description: SteelType is a powerful offline AI voice typing and real-time dictation translation desktop tool. Type 3x faster with absolute privacy.

posts.name: Investment Journey Simulator
posts.tagline: Simulate how real-life decisions reshape long-term wealth
posts.description: Investment Journey Simulator is an open-source Python + Streamlit tool for modelling how real-life decisions change long-term investment outcomes. Simulate SIPs, step-ups, pauses, lump sums, withdrawals, rebalancing, inflation, taxes, historical scenarios and Monte Carlo paths. Compare complete journeys and use Shapley-based attribution to explain which decisions created the difference. It does not predict markets or recommend investments.

posts.name: Nufa
posts.tagline: Read real books in your target language, tap any word
posts.description: Nufa is an e-reader built for language learners. Import your own EPUB or PDF books, tap any word for an instant translation, and save it to built-in spaced repetition with the sentence you found it in. Stuck on a passage? Get a breakdown of the grammar and phrasing without leaving the page. No more juggling an ebook, a dictionary and a flashcard app. Free to use, with optional premium extras. Available now on Android.

posts.name: Heart.fm
posts.tagline: Send love your partner every night, easy
posts.description: Send a little love note every night: a line or four about today, a song if you like, and a snuggle sticker. They answer in one tap.

posts.name: according to - Research Companion
posts.tagline: Investigate sources from highlighted text in your browser
posts.description: according to is a Chromium browser extension that checks claims on any page and reports attribution, not hallucinated verdicts — real sources, weighed by a sources-list you curate. YOU decide the trustworthiness of the sources - the AI measures claims against your sources. I want to give consumers of information agency while using AI sustainably. I tested this rigorously, but still be aware: AI can make mistakes.

posts.name: DuoBar

posts.description: DuoBar is a small macOS menu bar app inspired by the iPhone Duo status bar icon. You can also choose what you want to see and how it's arranged. :)

You stay safe by never revealing your private contact details until you're ready. No unreliable algorithms - just authentic, real-life connections safely managed in one place.

posts.description: Free Microsoft Store app from CordiApps for live Windows performance tuning, cooling controls, and system health. Live CPU/GPU/RAM/network/thermals plus cooling and gaming-mode tools. Version 1.9.7.

Lou chases failed payments and closes the books, Frankie has your inbox, Hank notices customers drifting, Dale keeps you up to speed, and Inky writes the changelog. They work in Stripe, GitHub, Vercel, Slack, and Notion.

posts.name: Neomind Learning
posts.tagline: The superhuman math tutor that learns how your child thinks.
posts.description: For 40 years, research has shown that personalized tutoring outperforms 98% of classrooms. Most families could never afford it. Neomind is the world's first Personal Learning Intelligence. An AI tutor that teaches with the warmth of the best teachers, recognizing engagement, adjusting pace, and building rapport. It builds a Learning Genome for each child: how they reason, where they get stuck, what makes concepts land. Starting at $25/month for 4 tutoring sessions.

posts.name: PinLink
posts.tagline: “Link Once. Update Anytime.”

posts.description: A Photoshop MCP server that turns Claude Desktop or Cursor into your AI photo editing assistant. Every edit runs in Photoshop, on your desktop.

posts.name: Replr
posts.tagline: The AI keyboard that writes your replies from a screenshot
posts.description: Replr is an iPhone keyboard that writes your replies. Stuck on a message? Switch to Replr, screenshot the chat, and pick one of three drafts to insert without leaving the app. It works in most apps you type in, with Chat, Dating and Email modes and 40+ tones. Type what you want to say and every draft follows it. New devices get 10 free replies, no card, no sign-in (limits apply). Premium is unlimited under fair use, with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers.

posts.name: whichWay
posts.tagline: Interactive novels where you decide what happens next
posts.description: whichWay is a reading app where AI writes a novel with you and you steer it. Choose an era, a place, a genre and your characters, read a chapter set like a printed book, then pick one of three directions or write your own. A running chronicle keeps names and events consistent over many chapters. Ask about any sentence and get an answer from inside the story. Import your own manuscript to continue it. Books stay yours as PDF. No account, no tracking.

posts.name: Obvra

posts.description: Obvra helps game developers and QA teams automate gameplay testing, regression testing, bug reproduction, visual validation, and repetitive playtesting with AI.

posts.name: HomeNetworkInventory
posts.tagline: Beautiful self-hosted inventory for your home network & lab
posts.description: A lightweight, self-hosted web application designed to eliminate home network chaos. Track your smart devices, routers, servers, and IP addresses across multiple isolated locations (like your apartment, parents' house, or lab). Map physical cable connections, store credentials safely, and view everything in a clean, searchable Bootstrap 5 dashboard. No cloud dependencies, no heavy JS frameworks—just pure Python, SQLite, and full privacy.

posts.name: Zolt - Tesla Companion App
posts.tagline: Real-time Tesla telemetry & smart charging analytics
posts.description: Zolt transforms your Android device into a real-time Tesla telemetry command center. Built directly on the official Tesla Fleet API, it streams 230+ live data points with sub-second latency. Track detailed battery health, optimize home charging costs, and monitor drive efficiency metrics without wake-up battery drain. Designed for EV drivers who want granular, instant insight into their vehicle’s performance, thermals, and consumption analytics.

posts.name: RoleFrame
posts.tagline: Your resume, matched to the right jobs.
posts.description: Share your resume once. We read it closely, then rank every open engineering role across India by how well it fits you.

posts.name: Caveman
posts.tagline: Turn your GitHub repo into docs and visual insights.
posts.description: Caveman turns your GitHub repo into clear, useful insights. It analyzes your codebase to generate accurate, production-ready READMEs and visualizes your commit history so you can see how your project evolved over time. No more manually writing documentation or digging through endless files. Connect your repo, let Caveman analyze it, and understand your project at a glance

posts.name: BoostSkill: Focus Study Timer
posts.tagline: Gamified 100-Hour Rule focus timer & skill roadmaps
posts.description: Most focus timers only track isolated minutes or hide basic insights behind expensive monthly subscriptions. BoostSkill is an offline-first Android app built around the 100-Hour Rule—the proven principle that 100 hours of deliberate practice puts you ahead of 95% of people in any skill. Features: • 100-Hour milestone roadmaps • Evolving mascots that level up with focus • Pomodoro & Android home screen widgets • Focus Bio-Rhythms & 365-day heatmaps

posts.name: Typing Over It
posts.tagline: Competitive real-time multiplayer typing race rage game
posts.description: Race against players worldwide in real-time competitive typing games. Test your WPM, challenge friends, climb the leaderboards, and master touch typing.

posts.name: Homeoke: The all in one app for singing
posts.tagline: Remove the vocals. Change the key. Record your take
posts.description: First product launch for my singing practice app! I'm still actively adding new features but I think it's mature enough to provide an experience for people to enjoy and hopefully helps people to enjoy and improve their singing too.

posts.name: Budget Buzz Deals
posts.tagline: Real price drops, open-box and used deals without the noise
posts.description: See the usual price, today's price and what you save on new, used and open-box items, refreshed every morning.

posts.name: Foldout Capture Studio
posts.tagline: Screenshots, recorder, video editor & annotator for Mac
posts.description: Screenshot tool. Cinematic recorder. Video editor. Image annotator. Capture a scrolling page, record a demo with smooth zooms, then cut mistakes, hold a frame and add timed arrows or captions. Annotate any photo or screenshot with magnifiers, callouts and editable layers. Blur faces, cover private details, remove backgrounds, style images, present live and measure layouts. Processing stays on your Mac. All included: US$10 once for 2 Macs. Try every tool free for 14 days, no card.

posts.name: JobStal
posts.tagline: JobStal – Smart job matching platform driven by AI.
posts.description: JobStal is a modern recruitment platform that eliminates long hiring processes. Driven by AI, it finds the perfect match between job seekers and employers, connecting them directly via in-app chat. Build a profile and match instantly.

posts.name: A Flys Life
posts.tagline: Its brain is mapped. Its path is not.
posts.description: A Fly’s Life is a live digital experiment inspired by the mapped fruit-fly connectome. Watch a virtual fly explore a persistent world as sensory input flows through a neural simulation of 8,000 neurons and 170,000+ synapses, influencing every turn it makes. No predetermined path — just one digital fly and an unpredictable journey.

posts.name: Shipcheck
posts.tagline: Pre-flight security scanner for vibe-coded apps
posts.description: AI coding tools make it trivial to build apps, but they frequently leak API keys in client bundles, leave databases open, and expose unauthed LLM endpoints. Shipcheck audits your repo or live URL in 5 seconds and gives you copy-paste fixes for your AI agent.

posts.name: Filesmash Fast file manager for Windows
posts.tagline: Faster Windows file manager with miller columns
posts.description: Filesmash is a native Windows file browser built with C++/Win32 and a custom UI engine, without Electron or a heavy web runtime to make it feel faster, cleaner and more productive. It combines Column View, Quick Preview, fast search, tab workflows, Network Drive support, folder memory, cloud integration, and deeper control over the right-click menu, all in one lightweight desktop app. After months of private beta testing with 400+ of users, Filesmash is now opening up to a wider audience.

posts.name: Ocara
posts.tagline: AI-powered project management right on your board
posts.description: A Ocara reúne Kanban, sprints, roadmap e saúde do backlog num só lugar para times de engenharia. Configure agentes de IA por coluna do workflow para processar cards automaticamente, ou conecte Claude, Cursor e outros clientes MCP pelo servidor MCP nativo (29 tools). Integra com GitHub e GitLab. Plano grátis para até 3 usuários. Plano Business é R$149/mês, incluindo até 3 usuários, mais R$39/mês por usuário adicional.

posts.name: cueloop
posts.tagline: A terminal-first multiplayer thread for agent-authored work.
posts.description: cueloop opens your agent's plan or diff in the terminal, where you comment on exact lines and send back a Message it can act on.

posts.name: Dispute
posts.tagline: Independent work records when proof matters
posts.description: DISPUTE helps freelancers, contractors and independent workers keep structured records of their work, time and supporting evidence. Instead of relying on scattered screenshots, messages and notes, users can organize their records and generate a clearer report when work, hours or deliverables are questioned.

posts.name: Smarter Financial Analysis with FinEye
posts.tagline: AI-powered financial intelligence for smarter lending
posts.description: FinEye offers AI-powered financial statement analysis with tampering detection, cashflow insights, and faster decision-making for lending and finance teams.

posts.name: Pronunciation Coach
posts.tagline: Free English pronunciation practice for Windows
posts.description: Pronunciation Coach is a free Windows app for practising English with your own text. Select text in most Windows apps and press Ctrl+Alt+P to hear it instantly, then record yourself to get a practice score, recognition confidence and words to review. Local-first, no subscription and no app account required.

posts.name: UsingOpen
posts.tagline: Open models. No login, no logs, no limits.
posts.description: UsingOpen is a no-login playground for open AI models (GLM, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, and more). Built for: • Privacy: No signups, no saved history, and no prompt tracking. • Frictionless access: No token walls, daily caps, or paywalls. It’s completely free. Pick a model and chat with live streaming, reasoning traces, image support, and real-time status. Open a tab. Use it. Close it.

posts.name: frenzii — Shared memories
posts.tagline: Your People. Your Memories
posts.description: frenzii is a social media app built around sharing moments together instead of alone. Rather than one person creating an entire post, frenzii lets a group of friends collaborate on a single post, with each person contributing their own photo.

posts.name: Spatial Display
posts.tagline: Your Mac displays, spatial and interactive on iPhone
posts.description: Spatial Display turns the screens connected to your Mac into independent spatial monitors on your iPhone. Move your phone to look around with ARKit tracking, and interact with your Mac through touch, gestures, typing, and spatial audio. The iPhone app pairs with Spatial Display Server on macOS: sign in on both devices and choose which displays to share. Your first Mac display is free; Pro unlocks every selected display.

posts.name: KeyBid
posts.tagline: The keyboard where founders bid for visibility.
posts.description: KeyBid is a paid startup leaderboard where you bid to claim a key on a real keyboard. Pay what you want, outbid competitors, and get your website featured. The best outbid.lol alternative for indie hackers and founders.

posts.name: Keptick
posts.tagline: Catch missed runs and empty results in client automations
posts.description: Catch missed runs and empty results from client automations. Send an outcome receipt after work completes, check output counts, and share a private client status link. One monitor stays free. Up to 50 monitors cost $19/month after a 14-day no-card trial.
